quick_skim.title: Proactive Computing
quick_skim.abstract: Computing systems are moving from reactive tools toward systems that sense, interpret, predict, and act before explicit user requests. This transition is enabled by the global scale of mobile connectivity, the rapid expansion of wearable and ambient sensing, advances in machine learning and foundation models, distributed edge infrastructure, and physical actuation. We define \emph{proactive computing} as a paradigm in which systems infer user context, anticipate future needs or risks, and initiate information delivery or actions at an appropriate time. This survey distinguishes proactive computing from reactive, context-aware, adaptive, and predictive computing, and frames proactivity as a system-level integration problem across sensing, understanding, decision making, action, and governance. We review the technological enablers of proactive computing, organize its design space, analyze technical challenges such as uncertainty-aware triggering and the prediction-to-action gap, and discuss socio-technical issues involving user acceptance, trust, privacy, accountability, fairness, and sustainability. We argue that the key research challenge is not merely improving prediction accuracy, but determining when, how, and whether systems should act on behalf of users.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 本文综述了前瞻性计算范式，即系统在用户明确请求之前通过感知、理解、预测和行动来提前满足需求。文章将前瞻性与反应式、上下文感知、自适应和预测式计算进行区分，并将主动性视为跨感知、理解、决策、行动和治理的系统级集成问题。该综述为设计主动交互系统提供了理论框架和分类，有助于指导基于多模态信号的意图预测与交互范式研究。

quick_skim.matched_query_text: Papers central to 人类意图识别与人机交互（HCI）：基于多模态信号（特别是眼动追踪）的实时意图预测与交互范式研究。probabilistic modeling（概率建模）或 proactive interaction（前瞻性交互）, especially work that connects or combines: multimodal intent prediction eye movement; gaze-based human-computer interaction; eye tracking intention recognition; real-time intent recognition algorithms; real time human intent recognition using eye tracking data; gaze based interaction paradigms for proactive system response; computational models for understanding human goals through eye movements; probabilistic modeling of human gaze for proactive systems.
